");
  transform-origin: 50% 0%;
  animation: swayCanopy 8.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.petal-sprite {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 4;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-size: contain;
  background-position: center;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.07));
  transition: opacity .45s ease;
}

.garden-butterfly {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 5;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity .45s ease;
  transform-origin: center center;
  will-change: transform;
}

body[data-scene="Garden"] .garden-butterfly,
body[data-scene="Garden"] .petal-sprite { opacity: 1; }

.garden-butterfly .wing {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  width: 54%;
  height: 100%;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-size: contain;
  background-position: center;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.11));
  will-change: transform;
}
.garden-butterfly .wing.left { left: 0; transform-origin: 94% 48%; }
.garden-butterfly .wing.right { right: 0; transform-origin: 6% 48%; }
